data.one_liner: A simple Dart class for validating email addresses without using RegEx.
data.what_it_does: Validates the syntax of email addresses using a Dart class with a static validate method. It does not look up domains or check if an email actually exists.
use_when: You need to validate email address syntax in Dart or Flutter applications
You want to avoid complex regular expressions for email validation
avoid_when: You need to verify if an email domain exists or if the mailbox is real
You need UI widgets for entering pins or handling other types of inputs
strengths: Simple and lightweight with no external dependencies
Works across multiple platforms including Android, iOS, Web, Windows, macOS, and Linux
weaknesses: Only validates syntax and does not check domain existence or mailbox validity
